vb_textbox.text: For me it seemed like the characters work in pairs. Sometimes it would be best to always pick the small gnomes for a few rounds in a row and other times the large gnome. When the mushroom 'drop rate' goes down switch to pick the other sized gnome. Sometimes the 'drop rate' is low regardless of which you pick. In these periods you either get 0-3 mushrooms. This carries on for quite a few rounds before returning to normal 'drop rates'.Be aware though, these are my experience, the study might pit you with a different rules/pattern, perhaps even colour based on the gnomes.The advice given to me by another participant was to say the colour of the gnome out loud, which I didn't do, and I do not think would have helped me.All the best Good luck.
